meta.title: Document view
meta.description: A split document view for DeepSeek Harness: the document stays centered while the conversation stays on the right. Select text in Word / PDF / PowerPoint to strike it out or leave a comment; the review panel lists every mark by page and sends the whole review to the AI as one structured message. After the agent edits the file, each changed span is highlighted in green (a deleted passage gets a green caret), so you can see what moved. Also: a resizable divider with keyboard support, three layout presets, auto-enter on document view, and a Document/Chat switch in narrow windows — saved per session. The plugin only rearranges the window and draws marks: no network requests, no file writes, no credentials; editing, saving and preview stay with DSH's native viewers. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.5.
